text: 1. **A mistake I made:** I ran real-money cross-mint sends while nutsack composed the wallet with `Config::new(None)` — **no persistent WAL**, which defeats the money-safe saga's whole purpose (a stalled melt couldn't reconcile). I've fixed it: nutsack now uses a durable WAL at `~/.nutsack-wal`. I should have caught that before the first real-money run.
